Risk Scenario: Phishing email enables credential theft or malware execution
Controls: Email filtering; awareness training; MFA; reporting process
Asset inventory; risk-based patching; vulnerability management

Risk Scenario: Ransomware spreads laterally across the network
Controls: Network segmentation; endpoint detection; least privilege

Risk Scenario: Backups are encrypted, deleted, or unavailable
Controls: Offline/immutable backups; separate credentials; restore tests
Least privilege; separate admin accounts; access reviews; MFA

Risk Scenario: Suspicious activity is not detected promptly
Incident response roles and communications are unclear
Controls: Written response plan; contacts; tabletop exercise

Risk Scenario: Sensitive data is exposed during or after an incident
Controls: Data classification; encryption; access controls; escalation path
MFA; time-limited access; vendor reviews; approved gateway

Risk Scenario: Recovery is delayed because restoration priorities are unknown
Controls: Business impact analysis; recovery priorities; tested recovery targets
